prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: ONE individual square PNG memory-game country-flag card, part of a coordinated 50-country collection.
Reference image role: STYLE, coloured-pencil pigment texture, cream paper, fine graphite outline and generous blank FRAMING ONLY. Replace the entire flag design with the requested country's true flag. Do not retain South African symbols or colours unless actually appropriate.
Style/medium: richly finished hand-drawn COLOUR SKETCH, finely layered coloured pencil and restrained gouache/watercolour on warm ivory paper. Visible careful pencil strokes inside flat flag colours; confident thin graphite contours. Match reference texture and workmanship. Neither photograph, waving fabric, CGI nor sterile vector graphic.
Composition: exactly ONE flat upright flag viewed STRAIGHT ON, no folds, no pole, no waving, no perspective, no page rotation. Correct native flag width-to-height ratio given below, not stretched. Centre flag both horizontally and vertically. Longest flag dimension exactly 70-72% of square canvas; all flag corners between 14% and 86% of canvas. At least 14% entirely blank paper on EVERY side. Preserve straight rectangle (square for Switzerland) and complete visible design.
Backdrop: uniform warm ivory cream paper (#F8F3E9) with very subtle grain, blank edge to edge. No shadow, scenery, map, objects, decoration or paper vignette.
Accuracy: authentic national colours and orientation with hoist LEFT. Carefully count all stripes, stars, points, spokes and trigrams. No invented symbols. Intrinsic heraldic emblems must be present where specified. Keep sharp readable large shapes and clean separation of bands.
Text: NO country names, captions, labels, signatures, numbers, watermarks, card border or unrelated writing. Only the genuine flag's intrinsic motto if explicitly requested below.
Output: one square 1:1 PNG, at least 1024 pixels, one single flag only.
Country and accurate design: Nigeria. Native aspect ratio WIDTH:HEIGHT 2:1. Three equal vertical bands GREEN, WHITE, GREEN. No emblem.
IMPORTANT: draw the NEW flag's proper aspect ratio and symbols; source flag is only a pencil/paper style sample.

composition_revision.prompt:
Edit this ONE Nigeria national-flag colour sketch. Preserve the flag's colours, pattern, pencil strokes, thin graphite contours, cream paper and intrinsic symbols. Change ONLY the FLAG RECTANGLE PROPORTIONS to the accurate WIDTH:HEIGHT 2:1. This is a square 1254 x 1254 canvas with the flag centred. Flag width should be approximately 900 pixels and flag height approximately 450 pixels. Its horizontal edges must therefore look clearly LONG and LOW, almost twice as wide as tall. The canvas stays SQUARE; only the rectangle inside changes. 
Accurate design to preserve: Three equal vertical bands GREEN, WHITE, GREEN. No emblem.
No label or added text, no pole, no waving or folds, no extra objects, no border around canvas. Preserve generous blank ivory margins, entire flag visible.
